reconstructed_theorem_text: For every real inner-product normed vector space H without a completeness assumption, natural N>0, feature:Fin N->H, selected i:Fin N, replacement,label:H, and b:R, assume norm(feature(i))<=b and norm(replacement)<=b. Let m=(N:R)^(-1) times sum_j feature(j), and mNew=(N:R)^(-1) times sum_j Function.update(feature,i,replacement)(j). Then norm(mNew-label)^2-norm(m-label)^2-2*inner_product(m-label,mNew-m)=norm(mNew-m)^2, and norm(mNew-m)^2<=4*b^2/(N:R)^2. Function.update replaces just index i and preserves all others, even if feature values coincide. These are actual means, with derived displacement mNew-m=(N:R)^(-1) times (replacement-feature(i)). The supplied individual norm bounds derive norm(mNew-m)<=2*b/(N:R), rather than assuming a displacement budget. They also imply b>=0; b<0 is inconsistent with the premises. Other features and label have no norm bound. The loss is unhalved and the subtracted cross term has exact coefficient 2. No measure, integrability, derivative, or abstract divergence hypothesis is present.
objects: H, positive N, finite vector family feature, selected index i, replacement and label vectors, real b, actual original and updated means and their displacement.
domains: H has only the displayed NormedAddCommGroup and real InnerProductSpace structures, with no completeness or dimensional restriction. feature:Fin N->H; i:Fin N; replacement,label:H; b:R; N>0.
quantifiers: For every H,N>0,feature,i,replacement,label,b, the two supplied selected-vector norm bounds imply both conclusions for the let-defined means.
assumptions: norm(feature(i))<=b and norm(replacement)<=b, plus positive N and the space structures. Nonnegativity of b is derived from norm nonnegativity. No bound on other features, means, label, or displacement is supplied.
conclusion: The literal unhalved squared-loss remainder after subtraction of 2*inner_product(m-label,mNew-m) equals norm(mNew-m)^2; that squared displacement is at most 4*b^2/(N:R)^2.
scopes: Both sums cover all N indices. Replacing one index does not replace equal values at other indices. Label is fixed and subtracted once from each mean. The remainder identity and budget concern those actual means, not an independently chosen displacement. Negative b gives no instance satisfying the premises; b=0 forces both selected vectors and the displacement to vanish. N=0 is excluded despite totalized real division. No abstract first variation is imported.
constant_dependencies: The exact factors are 2 in the cross term, 1 in the squared remainder, and 4*b^2/(N:R)^2 in the bound. The budget depends only on b,N and is uniform in label and other feature entries.
